name: MonarchCurrencyInput
title: CurrencyInput
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField (through MonarchNumberInput and MonarchTextField) with KeyboardType.Decimal, formatted with android.icu.text.NumberFormat currency styles (through MonarchMoneyFormat)
summary: A labelled field for an amount of money in one currency, typed and shown in the person's locale with the currency's own decimals, in major units or whole minor units.
whenToUse: For a price, a budget, a refund or any amount of money the person types, in a currency the app already knows.
whenNotToUse: To show an amount that cannot be edited use MonarchMoney. For a plain number without a currency use MonarchNumberInput. For choosing the currency itself use MonarchSelect or MonarchCombobox next to this field.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCurrencyInput(value: Double?, currencyCode: String, onValueChange: (Double?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, currencyDisplay: MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay = MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay.Symbol, minimum: Double? = null, maximum: Double? = null, step: Double = 1.0, allowNegative: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, showSteppers: Boolean = false, labels: MonarchNumberInputLabels = MonarchNumberInputLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchCurrencyInput(minorUnits: Long?, currencyCode: String, onMinorUnitsChange: (Long?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, currencyDisplay: MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay = MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay.Symbol, minimum: Long? = null, maximum: Long? = null, step: Long? = null, allowNegative: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, showSteppers: Boolean = false, labels: MonarchNumberInputLabels = MonarchNumberInputLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: value / minorUnits
options.description: The amount in major units (19.99), or in whole minor units (1999) for APIs that store integers. null while the field is empty.

options.name: currencyCode
options.description: The ISO 4217 code, such as USD, EUR, JPY or KWD. Sets the symbol and the decimals (JPY 0, USD 2, KWD 3).

options.name: onValueChange / onMinorUnitsChange
options.description: Called with the new amount, rounded half up to the currency's decimals, or null when cleared, on every edit that reads as an amount, in range or not, and on a step; an amount out of range is flagged when the field is left, so validate the bounds before saving.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while the field is empty and focused.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error from the app; replaces the field's own messages while present.

options.name: currencyDisplay
options.description: How the currency is written: Symbol ($ or US$), NarrowSymbol ($), Code (USD) or Name (US dollars).

options.name: minimum
options.description: The smallest amount. Without it the smallest is 0, unless allowNegative. Below it the range message is shown.

options.name: step
options.description: The amount one press of − or + adds or removes.

options.name: allowNegative
options.description: Allows amounts below zero, for refunds and adjustments.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field can be used.

options.name: showSteppers
options.description: Shows the − and + buttons. Amounts are usually typed, so they are off, as on the web and iOS.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the number field's strings: Increase, Decrease, "Enter a number." and the range message.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus and press interactions of the field.

states.name: empty
states.description: The value is null; the placeholder shows while focused.

states.name: amount
states.description: The amount in the locale's currency format, such as "$1,234.57" or "1.234,57 €".

states.name: not a number
states.description: A danger outline and "Enter a number."; the text is kept and the value is not changed.

states.name: out of range
states.description: A danger outline and the range message with formatted bounds, such as "Enter $0.00 or more."; the text is kept.

states.name: error
states.description: The app's message in place of the field's own.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background and the disabled text color.

states.name: read only
states.description: The amount can be selected but not changed.

appearance: The field is MonarchNumberInput, and through it MonarchTextField: a surface fill with the input border, the focus ring color when focused and the danger strong color in error; the optional − and + signs use the default or disabled text color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Formatting is MonarchMoneyFormat (android.icu.text.NumberFormat currency styles) in the current locale, so separators and symbol position follow the person's region as the web's Intl formatting does; reading is MonarchNumberInput's locale-aware parser, which ignores currency signs and codes around the number and reads (12.00) as negative. A typed amount is rounded to the currency's decimals when it is committed (Done or leaving the field), as on the web and iOS. iOS takes a single rangeMessage string; Android reuses MonarchNumberInputLabels, which also replaces "Enter a number." and the button names. The web's Page Up and Page Down large step is not offered. The keyboard is KeyboardType.Decimal; Compose has no signed number keyboard, so with allowNegative whether a minus key is shown depends on the keyboard app (a minus can be pasted, and steppers go below zero). The minor-units overload converts through BigDecimal, so 19.99 dollars is exactly 1999 cents.
accessibility: The field is the Material 3 text field: TalkBack reads the label, the formatted amount with its currency, and the error.
A message for unreadable or out-of-range text is the field's error, shown with text and a danger outline, not color alone.
With showSteppers, the − and + buttons are icon buttons named "Decrease" and "Increase" with 48dp touch targets, mirrored in right-to-left layouts, and the field has matching custom actions.
The text scales with the font size and wraps nothing away; the field grows.
edgeCases: An unknown currency code formats the number followed by the code, with two decimals.
The number field keeps three decimals while checking the bounds, so 10.004 against a maximum of 10.00 is flagged although it would round to 10.00.
Changing the amount from outside replaces the text on screen.
An amount too large for a Long in minor units is passed as null by the minor-units overload.

examples.title: Minor units (cents)
examples.template:
MonarchCurrencyInput(
    minorUnits = cents,
    currencyCode = {{currency}},
    currencyDisplay = MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay.NarrowSymbol,
    onMinorUnitsChange = { cents = it },
    label = {{label}},
    helperText = "Stored as ${cents ?: 0} cents.",
)
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencyInput(
    minorUnits = cents,
    currencyCode = "USD",
    currencyDisplay = MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay.NarrowSymbol,
    onMinorUnitsChange = { cents = it },
    label = "Unit price",
    helperText = "Stored as ${cents ?: 0} cents.",
)

examples.title: Cents stored as an integer
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencyInput(
    minorUnits = cents,
    currencyCode = "EUR",
    onMinorUnitsChange = { cents = it },
    label = "Price",
)

examples.title: A refund
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencyInput(
    value = refund,
    currencyCode = "GBP",
    onValueChange = { refund = it },
    label = "Adjustment",
    currencyDisplay = MonarchMoneyCurrencyDisplay.Code,
    allowNegative = true,
)
